 Brandin Podziemski fills stat sheet against Magic 
 by Chris Schommer | Warriors Correspondent | Mon, Nov 9th 2026, 12:27pm EST 
 Brandin Podziemski filled the stat sheet for the Warriors Saturday night, recording two steals, dishing out one assist, grabbing seven rebounds, blocking one shot, and chipping in 15 points (5-7 FG, 4-5 3PT, 1-2 FT) in a 126-119 win over the Magic. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Podziemski continues a modest stretch on both ends of the floor, finishing with one or more assists, three or more rebounds, and nine or more points in each of his last five contests. The guard offers head coach Steve Kerr a versatile option all over the floor on a consistent basis, averaging 15.8 points, 1.3 steals, 4.3 assists, and 5.4 rebounds per game to go along with a usage rate of 17.6% so far this season.
